content: In a footnote Melvin-Koushki reports that Muḥammad Ṭūsī, in his R. Majmaʿ al-Tahānī u Maḥżar al-Amānī written for Bāysunghur, refers to a majlis-i tafaḥḥuṣ u dīvān-i tajassus that was responsible for interrogating Hurufis brought to trial.
refers_to_primary: Muḥammad Ṭūsī, R. Majmaʿ al-Tahānī u Maḥżar al-Amānī, p.30 (per MK fn.99)
